title: Varda
description: Engineering-drawing navy: a deep blue page ruled with dashed blue hairlines, one loud orange for headlines and whole tiles, cool off-white text and light tiles. Square corners, no shadows: depth is flat colour blocks. One wide grotesk throughout, bold for the hero, medium for headings.
notes: dark is the faithful mode (the navy page); light is a sibling with an off-white page and navy tiles
Manrope stands in for MT Everyday Sans (closed): same wide set and large x-height
the gutter is fluid (16px on phones to 24px), like the original's gap
